frozen_at: the time in the RFC 3161 tokens on FREEZE.json (timestamps/), which lists this file's sha256
not_validation: A single case selected on its outcome. It is never counted as validation, never enters KOD calibration (call_type RETROSPECTIVE), never enters the paper ledger, and authorizes no order.

selection.rule: largest single-session close-to-close return of the home listing in the pinned price series (2015-01-02..2026-10-08)

price_input.source: Yahoo Finance v8 chart ZEAL.CO, daily, retrieved 2026-10-08T12:18:51Z

selection.bias: Selection on outcome. Any regularity found here is a hypothesis about other events, never evidence of an edge.

event.source: Nasdaq Nordic company announcement system (api.news.eu.nasdaq.com), market 'Main Market, Copenhagen'
event.headline: Zealand Pharma and Roche enter collaboration and license agreement to co-develop and co-commercialize petrelintide as a future foundational therapy for people with overweight and obesity
event.release_time_basis: releaseTime field of the exchange announcement system, queried with timeZone=CET; 2025-03-12 precedes the EU switch to summer time (2025-03-30), so CET = UTC+1
event.previous_announcement_by_issuer: 2025-02-20 13:00:00 CET, disclosure 1344296 (AGM notice); none between that and the event in the pinned feed

listing.reference_listing: Nasdaq Copenhagen, Main Market, ticker ZEAL, currency DKK (Yahoo symbol ZEAL.CO; Yahoo meta: exchange CPH, currency DKK, timezone Europe/Copenhagen)
listing.other_lines: The US ADS listing ended in 2022 (to be evidenced in step 2). Any US OTC line is not the reference listing and is not assumed tradable or informative.
listing.all_prices: home-listing official open, high, low, close and volume in DKK; no currency conversion

cutoffs.decision_cutoff_meaning: 17:00 CET on 2025-03-11, the end of the last Copenhagen session before the release. Fixed; if the official close is shown to be earlier, the cutoff is unchanged (nothing from the issuer was released in between).
cutoffs.information_rule: A fact enters a set only from evidence whose publication time is at or before that set's cutoff. Later accounts are RETROSPECTIVE grade D and are labelled as such.

evidence_plan.S1: Nasdaq Nordic announcements by Zealand Pharma A/S published by each cutoff: feed metadata, message HTML, attachments. PRIMARY; existence by PRIMARY_SOURCE_TIMESTAMP (the exchange system's release time). Bytes retrieved now and hashed; content verified only if an independent archive capture dated by the cutoff matches.
evidence_plan.S2: Independent archive captures (web.archive.org) dated by the cutoff, of S1 documents and the issuer's investor pages, when reachable.
evidence_plan.S3: Nasdaq Copenhagen announcements by Novo Nordisk A/S in 2025-02-09..2025-03-11 concerning amylin-class assets (the other Copenhagen issuer with an amylin-class programme), as dated market context.
evidence_plan.S4: Press and analyst reporting only through archive captures dated by the cutoff. Today's search results are leads, not evidence; a later account is RETROSPECTIVE grade D.
evidence_plan.S5: Copenhagen market conventions (session times, auctions, volatility guards, settlement, transfer taxes) from the exchange's and the tax authority's own documents. A document retrieved now that does not date its rule is graded and labelled accordingly; a convention not evidenced for March 2025 is stated as an assumption.
evidence_plan.S6: Prices: the pinned Yahoo series; cross-checked against a second source for the bars used in the entry analysis when one is reachable. Benchmark OMX Copenhagen 25 (Yahoo ^OMXC25), pulled with its own manifest.
evidence_plan.card: One RETROSPECTIVE KOD-CARD-v3 card, case_id KOD-R-ZEAL-20250312, integrity PARTIAL (price facts rest on a series retrieved now, which no evidence object can date), every non-null fact citing KOD-EVIDENCE-v2 objects where they exist; opened with `python3 -m kod open`, evaluated by the frozen KOD-DET-v0, closed with the event-session outcome.

fact_definitions._status: Operational definitions for this case's card. They define inputs only; detector logic and RULE_VERSION are unchanged. Price measures reuse E1-SIGNALS-v1 (idx-signals/research/E1/protocol.json) at the close of the last session at or before each set's cutoff.
fact_definitions.dated_catalyst_known: true iff a document published by the cutoff states a specific date, or a window of at most 31 days, for an expected event of the kind that occurred (a petrelintide partnership or licensing transaction). A longer window is false and is described in `catalyst`.
fact_definitions.catalyst: free text: the best-evidenced expected catalyst and its stated timing
fact_definitions.primary_document_public: true iff a PRIMARY document published by the cutoff discloses the transaction itself (the counterparty or agreed terms). Statements of intent to partner are not the transaction.
fact_definitions.price_already_repriced: true iff ret20 >= +30% (the E30 magnitude) at the set's last close
fact_definitions.volume_creep_before_story: true iff the median volume of the last 5 sessions divided by the median volume of the 20 sessions before them is >= 1.5
fact_definitions.price_quiet_vs_own_range: true iff the median rngr over the last 5 sessions is <= 1.0 and |ret5| <= 2 x vol20 x sqrt(5)
fact_definitions.narrative_only: true iff support for the expected catalyst comes only from SECONDARY or RETROSPECTIVE sources; false if a PRIMARY document states the intent
fact_definitions.mechanism_in_primary_docs: true iff a PRIMARY document published by the cutoff states how value would be realized (for example a stated plan to partner the asset and on what terms or timing)
fact_definitions.reconstruction_status: PARTIAL_PUBLIC for every set: exchange announcements are covered, newswires, broker research, options and order-book data are not

entries._rule: Defined before any return is computed. Prices are home-listing official opens and closes. Pre-release entries are evaluated as what a rule would have needed to know, not as trades anyone could justify.
entries.E1_PRE_T30D: close of the first session at or after the T-30D cutoff (2025-02-10)
entries.E2_PRE_T24H: close of the session that ends at the T-24H cutoff (2025-03-10); the T-72H set maps to the same first-available close
entries.E4_EVENT_OPEN: official open of 2025-03-12 (the opening auction, the first home-listing execution after the release)
entries.exits: official close of the event session +0 (entries before the close only), +1, +5, +20 and +60 sessions
entries.path: lowest low and highest high between entry and exit, reported as path risk (descriptive, not profit)
entries.benchmark: OMX Copenhagen 25 over the same close-to-close or open-to-close span; excess = ZEAL net minus index gross
entries.liquidity: entry-session traded value (volume x close, DKK) and the share of it a reference position of DKK 1,000,000 would be

costs._status: ASSUMPTIONS, not Copenhagen facts; stated so they can be replaced
costs.auction_fill: the full reference position fills at the official auction price (not verifiable from daily bars)
costs.transfer_tax: none modelled; whether any applies is a step-2 evidence item
not_assumed: an OTC line as an execution venue

conclusion_criteria._rule: Fixed now. The pilot ends with exactly one of FROZEN_HYPOTHESIS (untested, for independent testing) or NO_ACTIONABLE_EDGE_ESTABLISHED. A single case cannot establish an edge in either direction.
conclusion_criteria.C1_ex_ante: The condition is visible in an information set built only from evidence graded A, B or C published by that set's cutoff, without the outcome.
conclusion_criteria.C2_general: The condition is stated without Zealand-specific constants (no ticker, date, counterparty or deal size) and defines a population with other members, so it can be tested on events not used here.
conclusion_criteria.C3_feasible: An entry the condition would trigger exists on the home listing at a published price, with entry-session traded value at least 20 x the reference position, and its net return at the +5-session exit under base costs is positive and above the benchmark.
conclusion_criteria.C4_falsifiable: Population, trigger, entry, exit, horizon, costs, benchmark, minimum sample and success threshold are written down, and the test data exclude Zealand 2025-03.
conclusion_criteria.post_release_hypotheses: A post-release (drift) hypothesis is held to the same four criteria, with the release itself as the trigger.
